input.final_summary: Under `AXEL/axel_project/combat`, combat chrome styling lives mainly in `combat_test.gd` (dynamic StyleBoxes, side/history headers, stake pill, bankroll font), `combat_test.tscn` (embedded StyleBoxFlats, root theme, spin/overlay panels), `terminal_theme.tres` (VT323 + default control colors/sizes), and `combat_root.tscn`/ `combat_root.gd` for in-grid labels and frame border. `combat_test.gd` defines `_corner_box_style()` matching the scene but it is not called—corner boxes come from the `.tscn` sub-resource or are stripped to empty on meta/goal.

content.text:
## Combat UI styling map (`AXEL/axel_project/combat`)

### Global theme and fonts
- **`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/ui/terminal_theme.tres`** — Project `Theme`: `default_font` → `res://combat/ui/fonts/VT323-Regular.ttf`, `default_font_size = 32`, per-type overrides (`Label`, `Button`, `SpinBox`, `LineEdit`, `CheckBox`) for `font_sizes/font_size` and red/pink `font_color` / interaction colors.

### Scene resources (panels, titles, bankroll, spin chrome)
- **`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn`** — Root `Control` `theme = terminal_theme.tres`. Embedded **`StyleBoxFlat`** sub-resources: `StyleBoxFlat_corner_box` (MetaBox/GoalBox `theme_override_styles/panel`), `StyleBoxFlat_spin_*` (SPIN/EXECUTE button states), `StyleBoxFlat_encounter_win_panel`, `StyleBoxFlat_super_fs_choice_panel`. **`BankrollLabel`**: `theme_override_font_sizes/font_size = 36`. Overlay title labels (e.g. encounter win / super FS) use large `font_size`, `font_color`, `font_outline_color`, `outline_size`. Scanline shader material on overlay branch (separate from typography).

- **`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scenes/combat_root.tscn`** — Embedded grid chrome: **`GridFrame`** (`ReferenceRect`) `border_color` / `border_width`; **`GridUI`** `theme_override_constants/h_separation` & `v_separation`. **`RoundWinningsLabel`**: `theme` + `theme_override_font_sizes/font_size = 20`. **`EncounterWonLabel`**: title-like styling (`font_size` 42, `font_color`, `font_outline_color`, `outline_size`).

### Scripts (runtime overrides and layout constants)
- **`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd`**  
  - **Layout constants** (bankroll band): `LAYOUT_BANKROLL_START`, `LAYOUT_BANKROLL_END`, `LAYOUT_CENTER_HUD_Y0` / `Y1`; **typography constants**: `SIDE_PANEL_HEADER_FONT`, `SIDE_PANEL_BODY_FONT`, `SIDE_PANEL_HINT_FONT`, `GOAL_LABEL_FONT`, `WINNINGS_READOUT_FONT`, `WINNINGS_READOUT_OUTLINE`, `META_ICON_FONT`, etc.  
  - **Titles / section headers**: `_build_history_placeholder()` — `HistoryHeader` label: `SIDE_PANEL_HEADER_FONT`, muted red `font_color`; `_make_side_panel()` — centered header with same font + color; `_build_item_picker()` — `_item_picker_title` uses `SIDE_PANEL_HEADER_FONT`.  
  - **History “list”**: placeholder is a `VBoxContainer` with `separation` 4 and a `ScrollContainer` + inner list only in `_make_side_panel` (ITEMS); history panel currently holds header + empty `Control` placeholder (`HistoryPlaceholder`), not a populated list style.  
  - **Rectangles / panels**: `_side_panel_style()` → `StyleBoxFlat` (bg/border/margins) applied in `_make_side_panel`; `_strip_corner_panel_boxes()` replaces Meta/Goal `panel` with **`StyleBoxEmpty`**; premium meter **`ProgressBar`** gets programmatic `StyleBoxFlat` on `"background"` and `"fill"`.  
  - **Stake**: `_style_stake_pill()` — `StakePill` `PanelContainer` with rounded `StyleBoxFlat` on `"panel"`; **`bet_label`** `font_size` 22.  
  - **Bankroll**: `_apply_responsive_layout()` calls `bankroll_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 36)` (reinforces scene).  
  - **Winnings readout**: `_configure_winnings_readout()` — `mult_label` font size, white outline color, `outline_size`.  
  - **`_corner_box_style()`** — same visual intent as `combat_test.tscn`’s `StyleBoxFlat_corner_box`, but **no callers** in-repo (corners come from `.tscn` until stripped).

- **`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd`** — **`RoundWinningsLabel`**: in `_ready`, `add_theme_color_override("font_outline_color", ...)`, `add_theme_constant_override("outline_size", 1)`. **`_ensure_power_intro_fallback_label()`** — dynamic label with `font_size` 22, gold `font_color`, dark outline (power-intro overlay, not a main HUD title).

### Related (not main HUD chrome)
- **`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/symbol_slot.gd`** — `_ensure_win_label()`: small win popup on cells (font/outline), not bankroll/history/titles.  
- **`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/premium_meter_circle.gd`** — Canvas draw/animation for ring meter; no theme StyleBox for labels/panels.  
- **`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scenes/goal_hud.tscn`** — Minimal `GoalLabel` / `BudgetLabel` nodes; sizing in scene only, fonts largely driven by `combat_test.gd` on the embedded goal label instance.
